queries:
WITH country_counts AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS country_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
country_stats AS (
    SELECT
        country_count,
        1.0 * country_count / SUM(country_count) OVER () AS country_share,
        AVG(country_count) OVER () AS average_country_count
    FROM country_counts
)
SELECT
    SUM(country_count) AS qualifying_country_count_sum,
    AVG(country_share) AS mean_share,
    AVG(country_count - average_country_count) AS mean_excess_count
FROM country_stats
WHERE country_count > average_country_count

WITH country_counts AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player AS p
    JOIN player_college AS pc ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
    JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id
    WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
country_stats AS (
    SELECT
        player_count,
        1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share,
        AVG(player_count) OVER () AS average_count
    FROM country_counts
)
SELECT
    SUM(player_count) AS total_qualifying_players,
    AVG(share) AS mean_share,
    AVG(player_count - average_count) AS mean_excess_count
FROM country_stats
WHERE player_count > average_count;
